g.text: RestNotes - conditional note update and atomic snapshot
Bearer authentication and DTO/body validation occur first.
Existing-note PUT/PATCH and tag writes share this guard.
check archive and caller-scoped note ETag
reject malformed input before lease query
save immutable snapshot with sorted tags
Any validation/persistence/commit failure rolls back the whole transaction.
JPA row version and history sequence are independent.
Archive records activity without a duplicate snapshot and removes its lease.
